_note: The naming graph spike_names serves. Read corpus/state/README.md first. Two readers share no code: orbweaver-test's loader (orbweaver_dynamic::json) and spikes/seed_naming_client.py (stdlib json, omniORB's CosNaming stubs).
_provenance: Transcribed 2026-08-26 from crates/orbweaver-giop/src/bin/spike_names.rs, which still builds this graph inline. This file does not replace that code -- the fixture was not migrated (see README, 'What is not claimed here'). It STATES the graph, so that an ORB which is not ours can check the wire against a named population instead of against values typed a second time in the checking script.

reference_template._note: Every value bound in this graph is this shape, differing only in object_key. RFC 5737 TEST-NET-1, deliberately undialable.

bindings._why: A component whose id carries a space and a non-empty kind. The corbaname URL escaping is the assertion: a reader that stringifies this wrong produces a name the other end cannot resolve.

absent._why: Bound and then unbound. Absent is a stated property of this population, not the absence of a statement: a resolve here must raise NotFound with why=missing_node and rest=[Gone], which is a stronger claim than 'we did not check'.

root_bindings._why: list() over the root. Both are contexts, and there are exactly two -- a third would mean something bound a name this population does not state.
